summary: SimpleDMS is an open-source document management system designed to organise files using metadata. It helps small businesses handle document storage and retrieval without complex manual categorisation.
goodFor: Small teams looking for a straightforward, self-hosted repository to organise internal documents and reduce administrative overhead.
watchOut: With a modest community and lower repository activity, you may encounter fewer plugins, extensions, or troubleshooting resources compared to more mainstream alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for file storage and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
